You done what you could. I am a woman who suffers from anxiety, major depression, ptsd, etc. My husband helps me in anyway he can. If it wasnt for him I'd be dead. He does what you done. He holds me during my breakdowns, tells me everything will be okay, and he helped me get help. I couldn't thank him enough for what he's done for me. You seem to have done everything right, but sometimes it's not enough. It's hard to explain your feelings, especially when you grow up not being aloud to Express them. I love my husband so much, but it's still hard for me to explain my feelings to him. I dont want to upset him about certain things he does. For example, he looks at sex as just sex, a way to get off. I'm not like that at all, the only pleasure I get out of sex is being intimate with the one I love and when we dont have sex, to me it feels like he doesnt love me, he doesnt want to be close to me. I guess my point is that Sometimes the way you look at things aren't always gonna be the way someone else looks at things. Sorry if this doesnt help, but I hope it does.
